intro.data: Several machines are available, but only one accepts this input and produces what you need.
intro.alchemy: Several apparatuses are available, but only one accepts this material and produces what you need.
intro.spellcraft: Several runes are available, but only one accepts this essence and produces what you need.
intro.abstract: Several processes are available, but only one has matching input and output.

goal.data: Pick the one machine whose input and output types fit, and connect it.
goal.alchemy: Pick the one apparatus whose input and output fit, and connect it.
goal.spellcraft: Pick the one rune whose input and output fit, and connect it.
goal.abstract: Pick the one process whose source and target match, and connect it.
